system.description:
This trait is only available to biomorphs. The genetic rights management of this morph uses a number of atypical tricks to prevent the morph from breeding or being modified without authorization.

Unless “unlocked” with further genehacking by someone with
detailed knowledge of the original design or by a Medicine: Biotech Test at −30, the morph is sterile and will reject all bioware, cyberware, and nanoware mods not included in the original design (if installed, treat as a wound until they are removed).
